# 00000002091

**SY-11 ★** — source: 55_辛几何与镜像对称.md

**English.** Definition: Split-generation of the Fukaya category. Conjecture: The Fukaya category of the flag variety Fl(n) is split-generated by the dual flags (single-orbit Lagrangians) (flag variety split generation).

**中文。** 定义：Fukaya 范畴的分裂生成(split-generation)。猜想：旗簇 Fl(n) 的 Fukaya 范畴由对偶旗(单轨道拉格朗日)分裂生成(旗簇分裂生成)。
